diagnostics.title: HS220 diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: Collect a read-only report from paired HS220 switches through Homey. Takes about six seconds. Includes local IP addresses, firmware, transport metadata and cached status; excludes credentials and device identifiers. Share the report below with support.
diagnostics.finished: Report ready below and written to the app log. Null discovery means no matching response; null metadata fields were not provided. This scan does not test authentication.
diagnostics.error: Unable to collect diagnostics. Please check the app log.

credentials.title: TP-Link account credentials
credentials.subtitle: Use one default account for authenticated TP-Link SMART devices. A device can keep a separate account override when needed.
credentials.replaceHint: For security, the saved password is never shown. Enter both fields to replace it.
credentials.testHint: Enter an authenticated SMART device IP to test before pairing, or leave it empty to test eligible paired devices. This reads device information locally; it does not test TP-Link cloud login.
credentials.saveBeforeTest: Save the entered account first, or clear both fields to test the saved account.
credentials.validated: Local connection succeeded using the saved account settings.
credentials.unverified: Account saved; local authentication has not been confirmed.
credentials.clearConfirm: Clear the default TP-Link account? Devices using the global source will no longer have credentials until you save a new default or configure an override.
credentials.configured: A default TP-Link account is configured for __username__.
credentials.notConfigured: No default TP-Link account is configured.
credentials.deviceSummary: Devices: __global__ global, __override__ override, __legacy__ legacy, __unavailable__ without usable credentials.
credentials.legacyHint: Adopt only legacy devices whose complete local credentials exactly match the current default. Different local accounts remain untouched.
